newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Celsius in deal with Autoliv.
newsitem.headline: Celsius in deal with Autoliv.

text.p: Defence industries group Celsius said on Thursday it would cooperate with car safety equipment company Autoliv to develop a car radar system for speed and position determination.
Celsius unit Bofors LIAB and Autoliv already cooperate in the production of side airbags for cars, Celsius said in a statement.

"Through the new agreement between Autoliv and Celsius, the companies will further develop the technology that CelsiusTech developed for military radar systems to search for rockets and aircraft," Celsius said.
The cooperation would be on a 50-50 basis.
"The same technology would be used in cars to determine speed and position for vehicles," it said.
The system will increase car safety and make driving easier, it said.
